description.narrative: (Cambodia): Promoting Healthy Behaviors (PHB) improves healthy behaviors for Cambodians by reducing barriers to behavior change, both cross-cutting and specific to family planning; tuberculosis; malaria; maternal and child health; nutrition; water, and hygiene. .PHB delivers technical assistance to develop and implement targeted Social Behavior Change (SBC) activities. PHB supports a mass media campaign targeting adolescents and women of reproductive age to address family planning myths and misconceptions, and promote accurate information about modern contraceptive methods. PHB disseminates messages on TB symptoms and treatment adherence, antenatal and postnatal care with nutrition, and non communicable disease health education. PHB will expand malaria health education activities by using tools and materials developed in FY 2021 to cover additional villages in targeted provinces. PHB supports the National Programs for development of SBC guidelines, tools and other health education materials through digital technology, and provides the capacity building to program technical staff on how to implement the SBC work. PHB will expand the perception of health care campaigns through social media platforms and community health education work to improve early and appropriate health seeking behaviors that would benefit the overall health system of Cambodia. .The activity falls under the administration's "Advancing global health security, and mitigating development and humanitarian impacts" priority through improving the health behaviors of Cambodians. In addition, the activity contributes to USAID/Cambodia's CDCS 2020-2025 DO 2, "Health, education, and welfare of Cambodians improved through enhanced services" by improving health behaviors ensuring Cambodians seek and receive quality healthcare without financial hardship. This activity supports the ICS MO 2.3, Sub 2.3.1, "By 2024, quality of and access to priority health services improved."
